title: Diagnostic Credit Computation — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**The fee and the decision.** On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account, the diagnostic fee credited is the latest diagnostic fee charged on the account, and the line is its repair order and concern line. Wherever a record is chosen as the latest of its kind and two such records share that date, the one listed first in the records counts. The authorized estimate is the estimate amount of the latest authorized decision on that repair order and concern line, and the decision date is that decision's date. Where the account carries no diagnostic fee there is no diagnostic credit.

**Window.** On every account the repair counts as authorized on the date of the latest authorized decision on the diagnosed line, a later decision superseding an earlier one, and a diagnostic credit is given only when that date falls within the tier's diagnostic credit window of calendar days after the diagnosis date, the diagnosis date being day 0. The diagnosis date is the line date of the diagnostic fee.

**Clause.** The diagnostic credit is the diagnostic fee times the diagnostic credit share, rounded half up to the cent, and is given only when the decision date falls within the tier's diagnostic credit window of calendar days after the diagnosis date; otherwise there is no credit. The diagnostic credit share is the tier's diagnostic credit share.

**Assembly.** On a commercial fleet account the credit is figured in this order: first the diagnostic credit share is applied to the diagnostic fee; then every share this policy sets out that reduces the credit is applied; and the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. On any other account the credit is the diagnostic fee times the tier's diagnostic credit share where the tier's diagnostic credit on repair is switched on, and nothing where it is off, rounded half up to the cent, on the same window terms.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: fee 154.00, share 50%, window 14 days, diagnosis 3 March)
| Authorized decisions on the line | Decision date counted | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| One, 17 March | 17 March, day 14 | 77.00 |
| One, 18 March | 18 March, day 15 | none |
| 9 March and 19 March | 19 March, the later one | none |
| None | — | none |
